subject: Security gates and retention items for MAP — Northshore
messages:
From: Northshore Security <security@northshore.com>

Subject: Security gates for MAP with Redwood — SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention questions

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the demo earlier. As we build the mutual action plan (MAP) to move toward a pilot and procurement, the security team needs a clear list of the compliance artifacts and target dates so we can slot this into our intake calendar. Priority items:

- SOC 2 Type II report (current 12-month coverage) and control mapping
- Completed SIG/CAIQ or equivalent questionnaire
- Proposed DPA with our redlines (attached) and confirmation on any critical carveouts
- Data retention & residency: where logs and backups are stored, default retention windows, and whether we can configure shorter retention for our account

Can you share the above and propose a short MAP timeline that includes: evidence delivery, SIG/CAIQ completion, DPA finalization, and an onramp pilot date? We are targeting an eval start in early August but need to confirm security gating by 7/20 to keep that cadence.

I've attached our draft DPA redline and a short intake template.

Thanks —
Asha Patel
Security Lead, Northshore Bank
attachments: Draft-DPA-Redline.docx (docx, 48KB), intake-template.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Security gates for MAP with Redwood — SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention questions

Hi Asha (and team),

Appreciate the clear list. High level: Redwood can provide a current SOC 2 Type II report and a completed CAIQ export; we also have a standard DPA we can send for redline and a few options on retention/residency depending on deployment (hosted, dedicated, private).

Proposed MAP milestones — short and actionable so you can slot them into procurement:
1) By 7/02: Redwood to share SOC2 executive summary + control mapping and CAIQ draft (attachment: redwood-soc2-ctrl-matrix.xlsx).
2) By 7/09: Security review sync (30 min) to go over any high-risk control gaps and DPA redline items.
3) By 7/16: Final DPA agreement (DocuSign) and confirmation of data residency + retention windows.
4) By 7/20: Evidence handoff complete; procurement to confirm pilot start date.

On retention: our hosted default is 90 days for user-level request logs and 365 days for system backups; we can offer configurable retention per account down to 30 days for logs. For Private/VPC we can honor customer-managed retention.

I'll loop Kimberly (legal/compliance) and Jonas (solutions/ops) to handle DPA details and the DOCU-SIGN flow. Attached is the SOC2 control matrix export for your intake team.

If the 7/20 gating date is tight, we can prioritize DPA + SOC2 summary first and make CAIQ a parallel deliverable.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

On Tue, Jun 28, 2026 at 11:04 AM Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the clear list. High level: Redwood can provide a current SOC 2 Type II report and a completed CAIQ export; we also have a standard DPA we can send for redline and a few options on retention/residency depending on deployment (hosted, dedicated, private).

Hi Asha / Northshore team — quick internal note and proposed approach:

- Legal: we'll accept up to three reasonable redline requests on the DPA; anything outside our standard carveouts (export controls, govt subpoenas) will require a short escalation.
- Residency: Hosted (US) stores logs in us-west-2 by default; we can pin to eu-central-1 for EU residency or offer a Private deployment for full on-prem control.
- Retention: default user logs = 90 days; backups = 365 days; we can set account-level overrides down to 30 days for logs and 90 days for backups on hosted.

Proposed near-term MAP deliverable pack (I will own legal deliverables):
- 06/30: Send standard DPA + redline guide (DocuSign placeholder) and CAIQ PDF export.
- 07/07: Capture northshore feedback and produce an updated DPA for signature.
- 07/14: Confirm residency & retention settings for the pilot account.
- 07/20: Final evidence bundle handed off to Northshore security (SOC2, CAIQ, signed DPA).

Attached: MAP-draft-Northshore.xlsx (contains milestone table and owner assignments). Jonas — please confirm the operational steps for a 7/20 onramp (can we stage a canary pilot if the DPA is signed earlier?).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Security gates for MAP with Redwood — SOC2 / SIG / DPA / retention questions

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns to our internal slotting. A couple of clarifications before we lock the MAP: 

1) Data residency: confirm the location for logs and backups for the hosted option (us-west-2 by default). We need a written commitment that production data for the pilot will remain in the US and that EU residency will require explicit configuration.
2) CAIQ: please send the completed CAIQ questionnaire as a PDF output; our auditors want the full Q&A.
3) Retention exceptions: we can accept the 90-day default for logs for the pilot only if you can provide an account-level override to 30 days after the pilot is complete (we will document this in the MAP).
4) Backups: requested maximum backup retention for our procurement review is 180 days rather than 365 — are you able to accommodate that for the pilot account?

If you can confirm the three items above in writing and drop the CAIQ PDF + the DPA link (DocuSign stub), we'll proceed with the 7/02 evidence checkpoint and schedule the security sync for 7/09.

Asha Patel
Security Lead, Northshore Bank
attachments: CAIQ-filled.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)
